symptom: an attribute built as domainmodel.DateAttributeType (the date-only semantic type) is stored as DomainModels$DateTimeAttributeType with no LocalizeDate key at all, which Studio Pro never writes and Mendix merge/diff trips on
cause: attributeTypeToGen's DateAttributeType case returned genDm.NewDateTimeAttributeType() without SetLocalizeDate; the #743 fix only covered the DateTimeAttributeType case beside it
insight: Two semantic types map to one storage type; fixing one case of the switch left its twin. Written as true, because absent was always read as true (storedLocalizeDate) — false would silently change stored meaning. The MDL `date` keyword does NOT reach this path (the visitor maps it to DateTime), only Go API callers building DateAttributeType or ast.TypeDate do, so an MDL-level repro cannot show it: assert on the encoded BSON (codec.Encoder) instead of IsDirty
